python3 - <<'PY'
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from pathlib import Path

class ProjectCheck(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.articles = 0
        self.images = []
        self.placeholders = 0
        self.current_placeholder = False
        self.placeholder_text = []
        self.text = []
    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        attrs = dict(attrs)
        if tag == 'article': self.articles += 1
        if tag == 'img': self.images.append(attrs)
        if 'project-placeholder' in attrs.get('class', '').split():
            self.placeholders += 1
            self.current_placeholder = True
    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        if tag == 'div' and self.current_placeholder:
            self.current_placeholder = False
    def handle_data(self, data):
        self.text.append(data)
        if self.current_placeholder: self.placeholder_text.append(data.strip())

html = Path('projects.html').read_text()
parser = ProjectCheck()
parser.feed(html)
assert parser.articles == 3, f'Expected three project cards, got {parser.articles}'
assert len(parser.images) == 1 and parser.images[0].get('src') == 'assets/images/project1.jpg'
assert parser.images[0].get('alt'), 'Project image needs alt text'
assert parser.placeholders == 2, f'Expected two photo placeholders, got {parser.placeholders}'
assert sum(text == 'Photo Coming Soon' for text in parser.placeholder_text) == 2
assert Path('assets/images/project1.jpg').is_file(), 'Project 1 image is missing'
for title in ('Logic Gates on Breadboard', 'Hour of Code', 'Robotics'):
    assert title in html, f'Missing project: {title}'
css = Path('css/style.css').read_text()
assert '.project-grid' in css and '@media (max-width: 860px)' in css and '@media (max-width: 640px)' in css
assert css.count('{') == css.count('}'), 'Unbalanced CSS braces'
print('All three project cards, image, placeholders, and responsive styles validated.')
PY
